meta.name: add-imessage
meta.description: Add iMessage to NanoClaw — one channel, two backends. Local (this Mac's chat.db via the Chat SDK bridge; macOS + Full Disk Access) or Hosted iMessage (via photon.codes — native spectrum-ts with a device-login wizard; any OS, no Mac relay). Triggers on "add imessage", "connect imessage", "add photon", "imessage via photon", "native imessage".

copy.tagline: 让 NanoClaw 连接 iMessage 通道
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在使用 NanoClaw 并希望接收 iMessage 消息。
copy.tagline_en: Connect iMessage to NanoClaw as a channel
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use NanoClaw and want to receive iMessage messages.

howto.what: 给 NanoClaw 加上 iMessage 渠道:从 channels 分支复制并注册 iMessage 适配器、安装固定版本依赖、构建并跑注册测试,再按本地(macOS)或远程(Photon)模式写好 .env 并重启服务。
howto.when: 当你提到 “add imessage”“connect imessage”“add photon” 等说法,或要在 NanoClaw 中接入 iMessage 渠道时触发。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 加 iMessage,用本地模式(macOS)
say.note: 会复制适配器、写 .env 并重启服务

say.text: 改用 Photon 远程模式接入 iMessage
say.note: 会向你要 Photon 服务器 URL 和 API 密钥

say.text: 我从 +14155551234 发 iMessage,用它接上机器人
say.note: 会把它解析成会话地址

howto.what_en: Adds an iMessage channel to NanoClaw: copies and registers the adapter from the channels branch, installs a pinned dependency, builds and runs a registration test, then writes .env for local or Photon mode and restarts the service.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say things like "add imessage", "connect imessage", or "add photon", or want to hook iMessage into NanoClaw.

say_en.text: Add iMessage to NanoClaw in local mode (this Mac)
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, writes .env, restarts the service
Asks for your Photon server URL and API key

say_en.text: I iMessage from +14155551234 — use that handle
say_en.note: Resolves it as the conversation address
